svg.aria-label: AgentRQ speech-to-text: you click the mic on the New Task form and say 'Add a dark mode toggle to settings'. The first time, a Whisper model downloads into the browser; it turns your voice into text on the device, uploading nothing, and the text lands in the description. agy takes the task, asks a question, you dictate the reply, agy finishes and the agents celebrate.
